 Follow Donna Mills, 85, Reveals the One Fan Request She Refuses to Fulfill on Adult Subscription Service
 Amy Hogan Fri, October 23, 2026 at 9:02 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. KH1 / WENN.com / MEGA Donna Mills is considering giving her paying subscribers access to something they've never seen before, but it could come with a hefty price tag.
 The former Knots Landing star , 85, revealed that she might sell previously unpublished photos from a magazine shoot during an interview with ABC News correspondent Kayna Whitworth for Nightline , according to a report People published on Friday, October 23.
 Mills explained that some of the photos never appeared in the magazine, and she believes those images could be especially appealing to subscribers.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement When Whitworth asked what she might charge for one of the pictures, the actress hadn't settled on a price.
 "Oh, boy, I'm not sure. Maybe — I'm not sure, $100," Mills said, per the report.
 The actress also discussed her preference for photographs that leave something to the imagination, recalling an image from the shoot that showed her standing in a shower wearing a dress.
 But not everything Mills shares on her adult subscription page involves glamorous photo shoots. Some followers are interested in watching her go about her normal routine.
 "I do the Peloton," she explained. "Just, you know, they're the things of everyday life: having a cup of coffee, you know. They say they like it when you brush your teeth … I'm not going to brush my teeth."
 Advertisement Advertisement Asked whether most of her subscribers are men, Mills replied, "I think so. Yeah. Sometimes you don't know."
 ZUMAPRESS.com / MEGA
 According to the article, Mills joined the subscription platform in July 2026, saying she wanted to connect with fans on a more personal level.
 The decision has also paid off financially. During an August appearance on the Creators Inc. podcast, Mills revealed that she had earned "many six figures" in her first month.
 As Closer previously reported , Mills credits her youthful outlook to staying active and maintaining her ambition . During an appearance on the Really Famous podcast, she said she continues to pursue acting roles despite the challenges of finding work at her age.
 Advertisement Advertisement "I'm as ambitious as I was when I started out," Mills said on the podcast, adding that she works out almost every day and regularly plays tennis.
